"""The ``reports`` schedule."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated, final

from typing_extensions import override
from xtr_cache_contracts import CacheInterface
from xtr_dependency_injection import Target
from xtr_lock import LockFactory
from xtr_scheduler import RecurringMessage, Schedule, ScheduleProviderInterface
from xtr_scheduler.decorator import as_schedule

from app.message.restock_check import RestockCheck

__all__ = ["ReportSchedule"]


@final
@as_schedule("reports")
class ReportSchedule(ScheduleProviderInterface):
    """The ``reports`` schedule; describe what it sends here."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        cache: Annotated[CacheInterface, Target("scheduler")],
        lock_factory: LockFactory,
    ) -> None:
        """Build the schedule, its state in ``cache``, under a ``lock_factory`` lock."""
        self._schedule = (
            Schedule(
                RecurringMessage.every("1 hour", RestockCheck()),
            )
            # Keep what ran in the scheduler cache pool, so a restart resumes.
            .stateful(cache)
            # Send from one worker only: the one holding the lock.
            .lock(lock_factory.create_lock("scheduler-reports"))
        )

    @override
    def get_schedule(self) -> Schedule:
        """Return the schedule built once, with the provider."""
        return self._schedule
